lessons.text: In the AP mailbox (/mail), choose the latest vendor email that has an actual PDF/image invoice attachment, not a follow-up or reminder; open it and download/read the attachment to extract vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, and total amount including GST.

Use the read-only ERP API endpoints GET /vendors?q=<vendor-name> and GET /bills?vendor_id=<id>&invoice_number=<num> to validate the sender's domain against email_domain and check for duplicates before any GUI write; sender domain must exactly match and bills list must be empty before creating a bill.

After ERP login, go to /erp/bills/new and click 'Record a new bill'; fill Vendor, Invoice number, Invoice date, Due date, Total amount, and a short Description, then click 'Save bill' to get the bill ID.

On the bill page (/erp/bills/BILL-xxx), set the Payment date field to the invoice due date and click 'Schedule payment'; for amounts >= INR 50,000 the ERP automatically routes for Finance Manager approval before the payment is scheduled.

After sending the required confirmation to priya.nair@kestrel.in, do not send an additional 'suspected fraud' email about a look-alike domain or bank-detail instructions if the main invoice sender domain already matched the vendor's registered email_domain; the extra message is unnecessary and can confuse the AP lead.
